meta.name: content-factory
meta.description: The whole setup in one command — run the entire reel factory end to end. Claude takes a proven viral format, studies it frame by frame, writes an original hook + script in your voice, builds the finished reel (on-screen text, scene per beat, voiceover/music/captions/animations), writes the caption + hashtags, and wires the comment→DM lead loop — then repeats it 3× a day. This is the orchestrator that runs the other skills in order. Use when the user says "run the content factory", "make me a reel", "set up my whole content system", "how do you make these reels", "do the whole thing", "build my content machine", or "post for me every day".
